# iart-ai web-animation — vendor hub

This vendor has no single master skill; it ships 9 tools, each a command of its own.
`/design-tools:iart <tool> <target>` runs that tool; `/design-tools:iart` alone lists them.

**Request:** $ARGUMENTS

## Do

- If the request starts with one of the tool names below, run it exactly as its own command would
  (`commands/<command>.md`): resolve with `bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/resolve.sh" <tool>`,
  load (`load: skill` → Skill tool; `load: read` → Read and follow, base first), brand contract before
  any write, run, report what changed. Read-only tools change nothing.
- If it names none of them, print the list below with one line each and ask which one — do not guess,

## Tools

- `/design-tools:iart-60fps-animation` — Makes janky CSS animation hit 60fps. (writes)
- `/design-tools:iart-accessible-animation` — Honours prefers-reduced-motion with accessible motion patterns. (writes)
- `/design-tools:iart-ascii-animation` — ASCII and text-based animation effects. (writes)
- `/design-tools:iart-glassmorphism` — Frosted-glass surfaces done right. (writes)
- `/design-tools:iart-gsap-web` — GSAP recipes: ScrollTrigger, pinning, scrub, SplitText, Flip, Lenis. (writes)
- `/design-tools:iart-lottie-animation` — Embeds and controls Lottie animations. (writes)
- `/design-tools:iart-micro-interaction` — Micro-interaction recipes: hover, press, toggle, feedback. (writes)
- `/design-tools:iart-page-transition-animation` — Page and view transitions. (writes)
- `/design-tools:iart-svg-animation` — SVG path, morph and line-drawing animation. (writes)

Vendor card: `wiki/vendors/iart.md` · vendor contract: How-to, not taste. Reach for these once the motion decision is made and a specific technique is named.
